summary.text: Ron Ferguson is a Republican state representative from Ohio who has represented District 96 since January 2021 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A former television news reporter, he is vice chair of the Government Oversight Committee.

paragraphs.text: Ron Ferguson was born and lives in Wintersville, Ohio, graduated from Indian Creek High School in 2004, and earned a B.A. in communications from Ohio State University in 2008.
His career experience includes work as a television and radio news reporter, a business manager and a pastor.
In a 2020 Ballotpedia survey, he said he had worked five years as a television journalist, most recently at WTOV-TV in Steubenville.
Ferguson was the Republican nominee for the same seat in 2014, losing to incumbent Democrat Jack Cera 53.9% to 46.1%, and he later took office on January 1, 2021.
In 2025–2026 he is vice chair of the Government Oversight Committee and sits on the Financial Institutions, Medicaid, and Technology and Innovation committees.
In the 2020 survey, he listed individual rights, energy, the Second Amendment, criminal justice reform and education as policy areas he is passionate about.
Ferguson advanced from the May 5, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Charrie L. Foglio in the general election.
